title: Higher Education Support Amendment (Fair Study and Opportunity) Bill 2024
short_title: Higher Education Support Amendment (Fair Study and Opportunity) Bill 2024

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would amend the Higher Education Support Act 2003 to lower the maximum student contribution for Society and Culture units by moving them to a cheaper funding band.
It would move Society and Culture from table item 1 to table item 2 in section 93-10, reducing the maximum charge from $15,142 to $4,124 per student per unit.
The change would apply to units of study whose census date is on or after 1 January 2025, and the explanatory memorandum states the bill would have no financial impact.
changes: Society and Culture would be removed from table item 1 of the maximum student contribution table in section 93-10, including from the grandfathered student amount.
Society and Culture would be inserted into table item 2 alongside Visual and Performing Arts and English, for both grandfathered and non-grandfathered students.
The new amounts would apply to units of study whose census date falls on or after 1 January 2025.
The sponsor said the Job-ready Graduates policy had significantly raised student contributions for several Arts courses but had only a minimal effect on shaping tertiary education choices.
summary.affected: Students enrolled in Society and Culture units, including grandfathered students, and the tertiary education institutions that charge student contributions are affected.
